title: Free the Apprentice
description: Nobody has chained Perrin to anything. They are watching the working take his color and calling it a wonder, and so is he. Pull him out of the circle.

objectives.description: Kill the onlookers before they can stop you
Kill the man running the working
Break the circle and get Perrin out

notes: The fight here is against people who thought they were helping him, not against captors in the ordinary sense. Perrin's condition after the working - what it took from him - is left open; a follow-up could show lasting cost, but nothing in this pass wires it.
